newsitem.title: USA: MidAmerican 515 MW Iowa unit seen back Wed.
newsitem.headline: MidAmerican 515 MW Iowa unit seen back Wed.

text.p: MidAmerican Energy Co's 515 megawatt Neal coal fired power unit 3 near Sioux City, Iowa, was likely to resume production Wednesday after being taken off line for a boiler tube leak, a company spokesman said.
"Right now we expect it should be back on line later today," spokesman John McCarroll said Wednesday.
The unit, about 15 miles south of Sioux City, was shut for the repairs on Tuesday, McCarroll said.
MidAmerican is the operator and has about a 72 percent interest in Neal unit 3, with IES Industries Inc subsidiary IES Utilities holds about 28 percent.

MidAmerican has a 100 percent interest in Neal units 1 and 2, with 135 megawatts and 300 megawatts of generation capacity respectively. The units were running normally at full production, the spokesman said.
MidAmerican operates and has a 41 percent interest in the 624 megawatt Neal unit 4, with various municipalities and other organizations sharing the remaining interest.
Unit 4, located about one mile from the site of units 1, 2 and 3, was operating at full power, McCarroll said.
